_doc: Per-page metadata for the Cat-1 standard renderer (tools/build-cat1-standard-pages.mjs). Each page is one taxonomy row; variants list the compiled record(s) + variant key(s) that group onto it. Numbers come from data/standards/cat1-compiled/<record>.json; this file only carries display + wiring. PDFs are added once generated (cta appears when pdf is set).

pages.name: Infant formula (ready-to-feed, liquid)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for ready-to-feed liquid infant formula, stated as-consumed. Every limit is the strictest maximum level any credible government sets for the liquid product form, converted to the as-consumed basis; where no government regulates the exact product, the limit is read across from the nearest government value.

connections.label: Program Manual — Infant and Child Foods

pages.name: Baby cereals & dry grain products
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for dry infant cereals and grain products, stated as-sold. Rice-based products carry a distinct inorganic-arsenic limit. Every limit is the strictest maximum level any credible government sets, converted to the as-sold basis, with read-across where no government regulates the exact product.
